summary: A private installation now finishes its install cleanly.

fixes.title: Private installs pass their final check
fixes.text: The final health check now checks a private installation's database the private way.

fixes.title: New groups are ready before members join
fixes.text: Adding a member to a group SecurityInsight just created now waits up to five minutes for Microsoft Entra, instead of stopping.

fixes.title: Support access step ends cleanly
fixes.text: On a fresh installation, the support access step now ends without an error.
